doc.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Four Wilson girls married to reverends; bishop uncles
summary: All four sisters married ministers, and several uncles were bishops, one of whom loved her singing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Since we’re talking about the pastor, your brother-in-law, and church, fill us in a bit on all of the people in your immediate family, who your sisters all married.
There are four Wilson girls, all of whom married Reverends.
Me included. All of the girls married preachers.
Was there an uncle who was . . . ?
There were several uncles who were bishops. One was a bishop of the American Lutheran Church. He loved the way I sang. It didn’t bother him at all. Another was a bishop in the Pentecostal Church.
